parsed.scene_description: The image depicts an industrial warehouse with a spacious, open floor plan. The ceiling is high and supported by metal beams, and the walls are painted white. Large garage-style doors line one side of the room, each marked with a number in red and green. The floor is made of concrete and appears to be clean and well-maintained. There are several forklifts parked along the left wall, including a red one with a yellow bucket attachment. A yellow caution cone lies on the ground near the center of the room. The lighting is bright, coming from overhead fluorescent lights. The overall atmosphere suggests a well-organized and functional workspace.
